retentionProvenScope: Real TypeScript engine + broker + durable store with synthetic stdio: original visible messages, registered artifacts, file bytes, thread ID, failed/interrupted receipts and idempotent compaction action survive restart with one dispatch. Native rollout retention is source-audited, not re-executed.
failureLimitations: Source and offline fixtures only; no live Qwen/MiMo inference, shared deployment, native binary reattestation, Rust build or native semantic acceptance.
Atomic rollback is NOT_PROVEN. Non-post-turn stream output can already be persisted; live history changes before checkpoint append; flush errors can warn and still complete.
No candidate-summary precommit semantic hook was found in the inspected local path. PreCompact precedes generation; PostCompact follows installation.

Empty/truncated/invalid or factually incorrect native summaries cannot be graded from id-only App Server compaction events. Only post-turn has an explicit nonempty-new-summary check; standalone/pre/mid can reuse earlier assistant text or an empty suffix.

Automatic trigger phase/reason and summarizer identity are not exposed in ContextCompaction item. Canonical model-request metadata must be captured by its owner; no trigger is inferred from user prompt text.

Missing usage remains null/unknown and does not reject settled compaction. Canonical completion currently invalidates usage, including native recomputed estimate emitted just before it; the estimate is not proof of actual occupancy.

No independent absolute compaction lifecycle deadline is added. 15 s RPC and cancellation timeouts are separate from native stream idle timeout; an acknowledged operation awaits terminal or explicit Stop/cleanup.
Native context-window trimming bypasses the ordinary retry limit and reduces the compactor input; preserved originals do not guarantee summary-only retention.

Optional post-turn failure can leave a started compaction item unfinished while the native regular turn completes. The current adapter fails closed on unfinished items; exact phase/failure metadata is needed before relaxing this check.

Native protocol failures retain failed compaction activity but the unchanged broker records an interrupted run conservatively, even after confirmed cleanup. Failed and interrupted evidence survives restart.
Four optional native-binary fixture tests were skipped because no qualified native fixture binary was supplied. Individual frames above 4 MiB remain unsupported.
